title: The Gravity of the Kuiper Line Revisited
author: R. M. Blackwood
blurb: Ulyana Kavanagh, an insurance investigator of impossible accidents, has spent five years hauling cargo through contested orbits. Then the station AI begins confessing to crimes nobody reported — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must prove a massacre happened when every record says otherwise before the fleet's truce expires.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
